other_conditions: Bride must be at least 18 years old at the time of marriage
Bride must belong to the Brahmin community and be enrolled in the Praja Sadhikara Survey (PSS)
Bridegroom must be at least 21 years old at the time of marriage
Bridegroom must be a Brahmin resident of Andhra Pradesh
Bridegroom's livelihood must be from Pourohityam, Veda Parayanam, or Archakatvam
Bridegroom must not be a full‑time employee, businessman, professional in other professions, or an industrialist
Application must be submitted 15 days before the marriage or within 30 days after the marriage
